title: Rotate an API key
text: To rotate an API key, open Settings > API keys, select Create key, and copy the new key into your integration. Verify a successful request with the new key before revoking the old key. Only workspace administrators can create or revoke API keys.

title: 401 authentication errors
text: A 401 Unauthorized response means the API key is missing, invalid, or revoked. Send the current key in the Authorization: Bearer header. Check that your integration uses the correct workspace key.

title: API rate limits and 429 errors
text: The API rate limit is 100 requests per minute per workspace. A 429 response includes a Retry-After header in seconds. Wait for that interval before retrying. Repeated retries during the interval also count toward the limit.

title: Export workspace data
text: Workspace administrators can export tickets and contacts from Settings > Data > Export. The export is a CSV archive. Download links expire after 24 hours. Export your data before closing the workspace.

title: Close a workspace
text: To close a workspace, an administrator must open Settings > Workspace > Close workspace and confirm the workspace name. Closing stops new ticket intake immediately. Export needed records before closing. The support assistant cannot close a workspace for you.

title: Set up SAML single sign-on
text: SAML single sign-on is available on the Business plan. An administrator adds the identity provider metadata in Settings > Security > SSO. Test sign-in with a second administrator before enforcing SSO for all members.

title: Invite team members and roles
text: An administrator can invite team members from Settings > Members by entering their work email address. The available roles are Administrator, Agent, and Viewer. Viewers can read tickets but cannot edit them.

title: Change billing contact
text: The workspace owner can change the billing email address in Settings > Billing > Billing contact. New invoices use the updated address. Previously issued invoices are not changed automatically.

title: Support hours and urgent incidents
text: Standard support is available Monday to Friday, 09:00 to 17:00 UTC, excluding published holidays. For an urgent service outage, open a ticket with severity Urgent and include the workspace ID, timestamps, and affected operation. This guide does not promise a resolution time.

title: Webhook delivery and signatures
text: HarborDesk signs webhook requests using HMAC-SHA256 in the X-Harbor-Signature header. Verify the signature against the raw request body with your webhook secret. Failed webhook deliveries are retried up to 3 times over 15 minutes. Use the event ID to avoid processing a duplicate event.

title: Import contacts from CSV
text: Administrators can import contacts from Settings > Data > Import using a UTF-8 CSV file. The required columns are email and name. Each file can contain at most 5000 rows. Rows with an invalid email are rejected and included in the import error report.

title: Data retention: support guide
text: After workspace closure, customer data is retained for 30 days before deletion. This support guide applies to all HarborDesk workspaces.

title: Data retention: policy appendix
text: After workspace closure, customer data is retained for 90 days before deletion. This policy appendix applies to all HarborDesk workspaces.
